corrected_fields.summary: United Airlines Holdings, Inc. filed its Q1 2026 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing Q1 2026 financial results via press release (Exhibit 99.1) and an investor update with business outlook (Exhibit 99.2). The filing is categorized under Items 2.02 (Results of Operations) and 7.01 (Regulation FD). The filing body contains only boilerplate, incorporation by reference to exhibits, and a signature block—actual earnings data and guidance are in the referenced exhibits (99.1, 99.2) which are not included in this filing text. This source is a company-specific corporate earnings announcement and does not address market structure or macro catalysts relevant to this finance research archive.
